text: The PM will take the minutes, finish the end report, and place the end report on a storyboard. G_ and G_ will present the prototype. Decisions include placing buttons on the top and menu on the bottom, teletext access via the menu instead of a remote button, adopting a single-curved design to meet budget, and keeping costs under 12.5 Euro with redesign if needed. Problems outstanding: budget overrun risk with a 12.5 euro cap and eleven euros spent, and the digital pen is not user-friendly and does not work properly. The color/cost strategy is unsettled with potential mismatch for target groups.
